summary: The Controller and Core update pages keep following an update while the service they poll is stopped for the package install, instead of reporting the refused poll as a failed update. One shared follower replaces the two copied loops (BUG-0442). API impact: none.

guide.reason: docs/guide/software-updates.md explains that the page loses its connection during the install and keeps following the update.

api.reason: Only the browser's handling of GET /api/v1/updates polls changed; the request, response and apply contract are unchanged.

state.reason: No durable state; the page only reads the helper's progress the host already records.

verification.method: web/src/updates.test.mjs (npm --prefix web test) and npm --prefix web run typecheck; the old loop was shown to reject the same poll sequence in a scratch script. No live update was applied: the lab Controller VM was unreachable.
